item.title: Bird watching helps build healthier brains, study says
item.description: In an era when many of us are looking for ways to improve brain health, a new study offers a surprisingly affordable prescription: birdwatching. New research published in the journal JNeurosci, the Journal of Neuroscience, found that expert birders boasted denser areas of the brain tied to attention and perception compared to novice birders. item.title: Another Blood Moon this month, sort of
item.description: The big show astronomically in March is another total lunar eclipse, more popularly known as a Blood Moon, the last one we’ll have for a while. It’ll happen this coming Tuesday, the 3, during a full moon, very early in the morning in the predawn hours. The only problem is that shortly after totality begins, the moon will set below the western horizon. item.title: Dan Vladar sensational again as Flyers beat Bruins
item.description: Dan Vladar stopped 26 shots, and Travis Konecny broke a scoreless tie 3:41 into the third period as the Flyers won their second straight game, 3-1, over Boston on Saturday.
